instruction.text: Read the end of the scene and answer the questions.

atoms.text:
(Mayor Magnolia starts to slowly back away, trying to move offstage. Thatcher the Thief notices.)

Thatcher the Thief: (pointing) Hey! Why are you trying to sneak away?! You said our jewels were stolen and then raised our taxes because of it! What happened to our jewels?!

Mayor Magnolia: (nervous laughing) I don’t know what to tell you. I’m sorry about the higher taxes, but the jewels were stolen. (points at the dragons) They must be lying!

Townsperson I: (angrily) She’s lying! I work in her office, and she’s been keeping the jewels for herself! She’s planning to build a palace in Austria with our tax money. A palace with a HOT TUB!

(Everyone gasps. Mayor Magnolia tries to make a run for it, but is quickly caught by the townsfolk.)

Thatcher the Thief: Mayor Magnolia, we are stripping you of your title. If you return all the money and jewels, we will forgive you.

(Mayor Magnolia hangs her head in shame.)

Townsperson I: (shouts) And you have to volunteer in the animal shelter! We really need the help!

(The crowd nods and murmurs in agreement.)

Thatcher the Thief: Alright, now that that’s settled, we can end our feud with our dragon neighbours.

Townsperson II: (yelling) What about our sheep! The dragons must be eating our sheep!

Ted the Tender: (shyly) We’re vegetarians!

(The lights start to dim as the crowd shouts “Thatcher for Mayor!”)
